mapper.select: SELECT uo.org_id FROM sys_user_org uo INNER JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = uo.org_id AND o.tenant_id = uo.tenant_id AND o.del_flag = 0 WHERE uo.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND uo.user_id = #{userId} AND uo.org_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY uo.is_main DESC, uo.id ASC

SELECT uo.id, uo.tenant_id, uo.user_id, uo.org_id, uo.is_main, uo.create_time FROM sys_user_org uo INNER JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = uo.org_id AND o.tenant_id = uo.tenant_id AND o.org_status = 1 AND o.del_flag = 0 WHERE uo.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND uo.user_id = #{userId} AND uo.is_main = 1 ORDER BY uo.id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT uo.id, uo.tenant_id, uo.user_id, uo.org_id, uo.is_main, uo.create_time FROM sys_user_org uo INNER JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = uo.org_id AND o.tenant_id = uo.tenant_id AND o.org_status = 1 AND o.del_flag = 0 WHERE uo.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND uo.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uo.is_main DESC, uo.id ASC LIMIT 1
